Amazon Echo Show 8 (2nd Gen) Smart Speaker with 8″ HD Screen & Alexa

The Amazon Echo Show 8 (2nd Gen) is a powerful smart speaker with an 8-inch HD screen designed to bring hands-free entertainment, smart home control, and immersive audio into your everyday life. Powered by Alexa, this advanced smart display combines stereo sound, a vibrant HD display, and voice-controlled convenience to create a smarter and more connected home experience.

Whether you want to stream your favorite shows, make video calls, manage smart home devices, or enjoy rich music playback, the Amazon Echo Show 8 (2nd Gen) delivers reliable performance with enhanced audio clarity and intelligent voice assistance. Its compact yet stylish design makes it ideal for bedrooms, kitchens, living rooms, and offices.

Hands-Free Entertainment with an 8″ HD Screen

Enjoy seamless hands-free entertainment on the 8-inch HD screen that offers sharp visuals and responsive touch controls. Simply ask to play movies, TV shows, news, or music from popular streaming platforms. The HD display ensures clear video streaming, recipe viewing, and video calling, making daily tasks more engaging and efficient. With voice commands, you can pause videos, skip tracks, or adjust volume without lifting a finger. This with display is perfect for multitasking while cooking, working, or relaxing at home.

Powerful Stereo Sound for Immersive Audio

The stereo sound system in the  delivers deeper bass, clearer vocals, and room-filling audio. Dual provide balanced sound output, making it ideal for music lovers who want premium sound quality from a compact. Stream music from Amazon Music, Spotify, Apple Music, or Bluetooth-enabled devices. Whether you’re listening to podcasts, playlists, or radio, ensures a smooth and immersive audio experience every time.

Smart Home Control Made Simple with Alexa

Control compatible smart home devices effortlessly using Alexa. The acts as a centralized smart home hub, allowing you to manage smart lights, plugs, cameras, thermostats, and more with simple voice commands or on-screen controls.

View live camera feeds on the HD display, set routines, or automate daily tasks to enhance comfort and security. intuitive interface ensures quick responses and seamless integration with leading smart home brands.

Crystal-Clear Video Calling & Communication

Stay connected with family and friends using the built-in camera and microphone. The supports high-quality video calls with auto-framing technology, ensuring you stay centered on screen. You can also use Drop In and Announcements features for instant communication across rooms.

Privacy Controls You Can Trust

Designed with privacy in mind, this includes multiple layers of privacy protection. Easily disable the microphone and camera using the dedicated button, or slide the built-in camera cover for added peace of mind.

Key Features

  • Smart speaker with 8″ HD screen for vivid visuals
  • Hands-free entertainment powered by Alexa
  • Enhanced stereo sound with dual speakers
  • Voice-controlled smart home management
  • High-quality video calling with auto-framing camera
  • Supports popular music and video streaming services
  • Built-in privacy controls with mic and camera off button
  • Bluetooth and Wi-Fi connectivity
